# vgtfm

> vgtfm (vision-guided transcriptomics foundation models) is the code for "Slide-level batch structure limits histology-guided supervision of transcriptomic foundation models" (McConnell, Nonchev, Koelzer and Rätsch, bioRxiv 2026). It tests whether matched H&E histology, used only as a training-time supervisory signal, can refine frozen transcriptomic foundation-model embeddings (Geneformer, scGPT, CancerFoundation) of 10x Visium spatial transcriptomics spots.

## Key Facts

- An encoder-decoder is trained to reconstruct the H&E morphology embedding (Midnight) of each Visium spot from its gene-expression foundation-model embedding; the bottleneck is the refined representation, and histology is discarded at inference
- Gene-side foundation models: Geneformer, scGPT and CancerFoundation; histology model: Midnight
- Data: 120 10x Genomics Visium slides from ten cohorts across eight tissues (skin, lung, kidney, brain, lymph node, bladder, mesothelium, ovary)
- Evaluation: cross-donor, cross-region and cross-replicate annotation transfer; effective rank, variance decomposition, CCA and scIB diagnostics; per-gene R² and GSEA; patch-shuffle ablations; Harmony, BBKNN, ComBat and scVI batch correction
- Main finding: histology-guided supervision gives no consistent aggregate improvement in cross-donor annotation transfer, despite much stronger transfer from histology alone. Gene-expression embeddings of spot-based spatial transcriptomics are low-dimensional and strongly structured by slide identity, which limits the shared gene-morphology signal available for cross-modal transfer
- Trained Geneformer autoencoder weights on Hugging Face: umcconnell/vgtfm
- Python 3.11, PyTorch, runs on CPU or CUDA GPU, MIT licensed

## When to Use vgtfm

- You want to know whether transcriptomic or single-cell foundation-model embeddings of spatial transcriptomics are dominated by slide or batch structure (effective rank, variance decomposition, scIB)
- You want to refine Geneformer embeddings of your own data with the released model: `notebooks/pbmc3k_embeddings.ipynb`
- You want to compare histology-guided supervision with batch-correction methods (Harmony, BBKNN, ComBat, scVI) for cross-donor annotation transfer
- You want to reproduce the paper

## Related Projects

- [AESTETIK](https://github.com/ratschlab/aestetik): Learns multi-modal spot representations from spatial transcriptomics and H&E morphology
- [DeepSpot](https://github.com/ratschlab/DeepSpot): Predicts spatial transcriptomics from H&E images
- [DeepSpot-M](https://github.com/ratschlab/DeepSpotM): Multimodal foundation model for transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from histology

## Installation

```
git clone https://github.com/ratschlab/vision-guided-transcriptomics-fm-2026
cd vision-guided-transcriptomics-fm-2026
conda create -n vgtfm python=3.11 && conda activate vgtfm
pip install -r requirements.txt
make test
```

## Quick Start

```
cp environments.example.yaml environments.yaml   # set data_root to the merged datasets
make smoke                                       # end-to-end on a subset, minutes
make all                                         # data → train → eval → diagnose → figures
```

## Citation

McConnell, U., Nonchev, K., Koelzer, V.H. and Rätsch, G. (2026). Slide-level batch structure limits histology-guided supervision of transcriptomic foundation models. bioRxiv. DOI: 10.64898/2026.09.30.755585
